name: UCI Energy Efficiency Dataset
description: The UCI Energy Efficiency dataset is a tabular regression benchmark for predicting building energy performance. Created by Athanasios Tsanas and Angeliki Xifara via thermal simulations of 768 residential building shapes in Ecotect, it models heating load and cooling load requirements as functions of eight geometric and physical building parameters.

verification.notes: Verified against UCI Machine Learning Repository (DOI: 10.24432/C51307) and Energy and Buildings 2012 publication. 768 building configuration instances with 8 input attributes and 2 continuous regression targets (heating load and cooling load).
